text:
rachel: quick sync — following the GPU saturation postmortem, we need clear owners for quota, autoscaler tuning, and the headroom runbook. want to close blockers this week.

tom: i'm on autoscaler tuning. i have a branch with conservative pod eviction windows + preemption buffers. testing pass looks promising but i need a perf run across 3 clusters. target to share numbers Wed afternoon.

priya: i'll own the quota request. opened CCA-4399 and requested quota lift for gpustream-prod. cloud asked for a 7-day graph and cost justification. i'll attach both by Tue EOD.

luke: i'll write the emergency runbook (who to page, quick mitigation steps, and escalation matrix). will include script snippets for emergency capacity upscaling and a prebuilt support email template. PR by Thu.

infra-bot: Incident 2026-04-GPULOAD: mitigation actions: limited burst throttles, scaled cluster+manual node add. Root cause summary: autoscaler threshold + quota limit.

tom: snippet i'm validating (WIP):
```
# autoscaler tuning changes
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2beta2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: model-worker
spec:
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 180
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 30
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: nvidia.com/gpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 70
```
will run chaos/job-sim tomorrow to validate.

priya: proposed timeline: quota doc Tue, submission Wed, cloud response Fri if no follow-ups. ok?

rachel: fine. please include expected sustained tokens/s and business impact if denied.

luke: for the runbook i'll add a short decision tree: when to reduce batch_size, when to switch to vram-light variants, and emergency node add steps with cost estimate. also adding a section for recurring incident indicators.

priya: adding dashboard links and the cost calc to CCA-4399.

tom: created a lightweight headroom alert (temp): Node GPU free < 20% for 5m -> pager to infra-oncall. it's noisy in dev clusters; will tune after perf numbers.

rachel: action recap: tom -> perf numbers + PR (Wed), priya -> quota doc + submit (Wed), luke -> runbook PR (Thu), tom -> alert tuning (post-perf). we'll reconvene Fri 9am to verify metrics.

priya: acked. i'll also request a cloud pre-approval call if needed.

luke: ack. will ask oncall for a fast review.

infra-bot: Follow-up reminder: review scheduled 2026-04-09 09:00 UTC.
